bio.text: Everton Blair Jr. was sworn into the U.S. House on September 1, 2026, to fill the vacancy in Georgia's 13th Congressional District created by the death of Rep. David Scott.
He won the August 25, 2026 special election runoff and is serving the remainder of Scott's term, which ends at the end of the year.
Before Congress he was chairman of the Gwinnett County school board; according to his campaign website, he was elected to the board at age 26.

sources.title: Everton Blair sworn in as Georgia's first openly gay congressman
